basic_info.description: Experience luxurious modern living with exceptional amenities in this spacious 2-bedroom unit facing a peaceful garden courtyard. The expansive living and dining room boasts impressive 15-foot ceilings with custom crown molding, while the two south-facing bedrooms on separate levels offer complete privacy. The property features an updated kitchen & bathroom with Porcelanosa tile, an in-unit washer/dryer, & warm cork flooring. Located in a retrofitted & beautifully maintained historic red brick building that was once a fraternal hall & the Salvation Army Headquarters. It offers an elevator with direct access to deeded parking & Butterfly MX security system. Located at in the heart of San Francisco, you'll have direct access to the vibrant Valencia Corridor and be within easy walking distance of Hayes Valley, Civic Center, the Castro, the Mission, & SoMa. Boasting a walk score of 99 & a bike score of 97, you'll appreciate the lively, walkable community atmosphere. The property is subject to resale procedures, with the City and County of San Francisco holding the right of first refusal. Qualified buyers can benefit from the City Second Loan Program on a first-come, first-served basis.   https://sfmohcd.org/city-second-details for application and program information.
